title: Protect customer complaint lifecycle and exact sales order ownership
description: Stage3 core settlement and exception closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Require live enabled identity, existing complaint menu and authoritative customer scope on list/detail/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete before counts, numbers or changes. Validate enabled customer, stored and proposed ownership, existing Description/ComplaintType/HandleResult length contracts; optional SalesOrderId resolves exact existing nondeleted same-customer sales order and live source-menu authorization. New or changed links reject cancelled source orders, while previously recorded historical links remain readable with explicit status and cannot be silently rebound. Keep null historical source semantics without fabricating links or requiring legacy complaints to acquire one.

Use compatible sales-order-before-complaint locking and transaction for edits/state/delete with persisted/proposed source reread; retain historical audit and no partial fields on denied/conflicting operations. Explicit cancellation preserves complaint history and has no sales quantity, receivable, receipt, inventory or financial effects. Do not arbitrarily prevent cancellation of source sales orders merely because a complaint exists. SQL actual controllers own/foreign/unmapped/revoked/disabled, wrong-customer/deleted/cancelled link and rollback, plus two-connection edit vs submit and source cancellation vs new linking yielding consistent eligible source outcome. Separate request DbContexts, meaningful unit and safe Release verification.

implementation_evidence: FinanceComplaintController in FinanceReceiptComplaintControllers.cs exposes unscoped lists/details and generic lifecycle mutations. Create/Update assign arbitrary CustomerId/SalesOrderId without validating authoritative linked customer, source eligibility or current permissions. FinanceComplaint already persists optional SalesOrderId; existing complaint menu and salesperson scope must be reused.
